subject: CS477
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. Coverage for English is excellent, with highly-viewed, relevant videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is weaker; no suitable videos were found for 'Static Single Assignment (SSA) Form' and 'Basic Block Partitioning' as candidates were either irrelevant, in the wrong language, or did not meet the minimum view count.

coverage.note: No relevant Arabic-language videos were found among the candidates.
Relevant candidates failed the view count gate; others were on unrelated topics.

videos.title: Static Single Assignment
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly relevant, concise, and peer-validated tutorial with a high view count that directly explains the concept of SSA.

videos.title: Lec-28: What is Control Flow Graph | Basic Blocks
videos.filter_reason: With massive view count from a trusted educational channel, this video clearly covers the essential concepts of both basic blocks and flow graphs needed for CFG construction.

videos.title: Lec-29: What is Basic Block & Flow Graph in Compiler | Partition Algorithm in Basic Block
videos.filter_reason: This video has the highest view count of all candidates and a title that specifically mentions the 'Partition Algorithm,' making it the most focused and peer-validated choice.

videos.title: Lec-23: What is 3-Address Code in Compiler
videos.filter_reason: As the most viewed video by a significant margin with a perfectly specific title, this is the most authoritative and accessible introduction to 3-Address Code.

videos.title: Compiler Design Module 51 : Stack Machine
videos.topic_ar: التمثيل الوسيط لآلة المكدس (Stack Machine IR)
videos.filter_reason: This is the only highly relevant video that passes all gates, providing a clear, module-based lecture specifically on stack machine architecture in compilers.

videos.title: CFG - Control Flow Graph شرح
videos.filter_reason: This is the only relevant Arabic video that passes all gates, providing a clear explanation of CFG construction within a common computer science context.

videos.title: Three-Address code & Quadrable|Trible (Code Generation) "شـرح" - Compiler
videos.filter_reason: This video has the highest view count among eligible candidates and comprehensively covers both 3-address code and its common implementations like quadruples and triples.

videos.title: [باهر] infix to postfix
videos.topic_ar: التمثيل الوسيط لآلة المكدس (Stack Machine IR)
videos.filter_reason: This video explains the core algorithm (infix to postfix) for stack machine evaluation, making it more specific and relevant than general stack data structure videos.
